name: B10-0209/2024 (Renew) – Hong Kong, notably the cases of Jimmy Lai and the 45 activists recently convicted under the national security law
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Hong Kong, notably the cases of Jimmy Lai and the 45 activists recently convicted under the national security law
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for Jimmy Lai and 45 pro-democracy activists jailed in Hong Kong to be released and all charges dropped. It wants Hong Kong and China to scrap the national security laws used against them. It also asks European Union countries to suspend extradition treaties with China and Hong Kong, and to consider sanctions on officials blamed for human rights abuses. These are requests, not decisions that change law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament is asking, not deciding.
- **Who it affects:** Hong Kong prisoners, activists, journalists, and Chinese and Hong Kong officials.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to European Union bodies and to China and Hong Kong authorities.
